claims.claim: reschedules in 30 seconds / reprograma en 30 segundos / replaneja em 30 segundos
claims.evidence: Live product capability: the rescheduling engine (CP-SAT optimizer) recomputes the plan from current constraints in under 30 seconds. Demonstrable in any live demo session.

claims.claim: Planners go from hours of manual work to seconds / pasan de horas de trabajo manual a segundos / passam de horas de trabalho manual para segundos
claims.evidence: Live product capability: before Acme planners build plans manually (observed in customer interviews, typically 3-4h/day); after Acme the rescheduling step takes seconds. The contrast is demonstrable in a live demo.

claims.claim: scheduler was spending 3-4 hours a day / programador se aventaba 3-4 horas diarias / programador passava 3-4 horas por dia
claims.evidence: Observed pattern across early pilot plants (multiple customer discovery interviews). Specific quantification (3-4h) is a representative observed range, not a controlled study average.

claims.claim: scheduler was spending half a day reorganizing / programador se aventaba medio día reorganizando / programador passava meio dia reorganizando
claims.evidence: Observed in pilot plants when a rush order triggers a manual plan rebuild. Consistent with the 3-4h/day finding; 'half a day' is the specific replanning event cost, not the daily total.

claims.claim: plant running 200 SKUs across three shifts / planta con 200 SKUs y tres turnos / planta com 200 SKUs e três turnos
claims.evidence: Represents a real customer profile observed in pilot engagements. Specific figures (200 SKUs, 3 shifts) are representative anonymized parameters, not a single named customer.

claims.claim: 3+ hours a day in alignment meetings / 3+ horas al día en juntas de alineación / 3+ horas por dia em reuniões de alinhamento
claims.evidence: Pattern observed in customer interviews. The '3+' figure is based on self-reported planner estimates in discovery sessions; not a controlled time-study.

claims.claim: rescheduling down from half a day to 30 seconds / reprogramado pase de medio día a 30 segundos / reprogramação passe de meio dia para 30 segundos
claims.evidence: Composite of the 'scheduler spends half a day on replanning' observation (pilot interviews) and the '30-second rescheduling' live product capability. The contrast is demonstrable end-to-end in a demo.

claims.claim: ROI shows up in weeks, not months / ROI se ve en semanas, no meses / ROI aparece em semanas, não meses
claims.evidence: No controlled study or customer-reported ROI timeline on file. This claim appears in executive_sponsors dm2 (all langs). Evidence must be sourced — a pilot case study with measured payback period — before this copy can ship.

claims.claim: OTIF +5-8 puntos en el primer trimestre / OTIF up 5-8 points in the first quarter / OTIF +5-8 pontos no primeiro trimestre
claims.evidence: No primary source on file. This specific +5-8 point OTIF improvement figure appears in executive_sponsors dm2_v1 (all langs). A controlled before/after measurement from a named (or anonymized) pilot plant is required before this claim can be promoted to demoable.
